metric: reward = clip(1 - sqrt(gmean(relative MASE) * gmean(relative WQL)), 0, 1), relative to the leaderboard's own Seasonal Naive row (score.py)

lower.what: Seasonal Naive, replayed here rather than quoted
lower.rationale: the metric is already defined against Seasonal Naive, so its own replay lands just above zero; the residual 0.008 comes from interval widths computed on the 16,384-observation context cap.

upper.what: the best of 130 complete systems on the pinned GIFT-Eval leaderboard snapshot (EXAONE-Forecast-Agent)
upper.note: unlike the pde-surrogate ceiling this is a real system anyone can submit against. The best non-agentic entry is 0.4723 and the best released zero-shot foundation model is 0.4488.

note: the normalised score is what should be compared across tracks; reward.txt keeps the raw value. This track's floor and ceiling are both real systems, so the scale discriminates across its whole range.
